name: Find and open a patient's chart
route: Command bar Ctrl/⌘K from any screen → chart (/patients/:id)

name: Check a patient's alerts, balance, insurance and next visit at a glance
route: Patient bar on every screen (active patient)

name: Answer a call and open the caller's chart
Chart a finding on a tooth ("30 MO caries")
Switch the schedule between chairs, providers or one provider
Check a patient in
route: Schedule — focus the visit, I (or the card's next-step button)

name: Write a clinical note
route: Alt+N → Clinical notes tab, drafted from the visit

name: Seat a patient
route: Schedule — S on the focused visit

name: Mark a visit finished (patient out)
route: Schedule — O on the focused visit (Shift+O is today's plan)

name: Confirm an appointment
route: Schedule — C on the focused visit (Undo shows); the day's list: U, then C per row

name: Check a patient out (charges, payment, next visit)
route: Schedule — O on the finished visit → Checkout (/checkout/:id): Enter pays what's due, Enter books the next cleaning, Enter checks out

name: Mark a patient ready for the doctor
route: Schedule — R on the focused visit

name: Take a patient payment
route: Alt+P from any screen → Ledger payment panel

name: Book an appointment for an existing patient
route: Alt+B (active patient) or N on the schedule

name: Create and send an insurance claim
Explain a balance / show the ledger
route: Alt+L from any screen → "Why this balance"

name: Estimate what the patient will owe
route: Alt+E from any screen (the patient bar's Estimate) or the Chart tab — type "14 D2740", the estimate shows

name: Verify insurance eligibility
route: Insurance tab — E; overnight batch for tomorrow

name: Book the next hygiene visit at checkout
route: Checkout — R (or it opens by itself when nothing is left to pay), Enter on the first suggestion

name: Send a task to a co-worker
Take x-rays with the sensor
route: Imaging studio (needs a sensor and the imaging bridge)
simulated: measured with a simulated sensor on a simulated imaging bridge (e2e/actions/lib/devices.mjs)

name: Add x-rays or photos to the chart
route: Documents & x-rays tab — U (file picker) or drop files

name: Update medical history (add an allergy or medication)
route: Chart overview — A (allergies) or Shift+M (medications), type, Ctrl/⌘+Enter; or click the line

name: Look up how much insurance benefit is left
Send a message in staff chat
Call a patient who is due for recall
Build a treatment plan
route: Treatment plans tab — N, "14 D2740" Enter per procedure, Ctrl/⌘+Enter

name: Have the patient sign a consent form
route: Treatment plans tab — Consent → sign on this device

name: Send forms to a patient before the visit
Change an appointment's type, length or note
Present a treatment plan and get it signed
Update a phone number or email
Print the route slip / walkout for a visit
Chart perio (pocket depths and bleeding)
route: Perio tab — digits per site, B/U/P markers

name: Scan a new insurance card into a policy
Approve claims that are ready to send
Take intraoral photos with the camera
Mark a recall call as "left a message"
route: Follow-up lists → Recall — one row per patient: Log call (L), Enter

name: Dictate a note by voice
simulated: measured with a simulated speech recogniser

name: Log a phone call with a patient
route: Alt+G from any screen (active patient) or Messages & forms → Calls → Log a call: type the note, Enter

name: Cancel an appointment (with a reason, and rebook)
Set up a new patient (with insurance)
Call a patient about unscheduled treatment
Clock in
route: Time clock (/timeclock) — I, or the user menu

name: Start or end a lunch break
Post an insurance payment from an ERA
Ask a patient for a review
Fill an opening from the ASAP list
Post a paper EOB / insurance check
route: Billing → Insurance payments (/claims?tab=checks) or Scan a paper EOB

name: Create a lab case
route: To-do & labs — L (active patient), shade, Enter

name: Check in a case back from the lab
Call an insurance company about an unpaid claim
Put a patient on the ASAP list
Send a payment link by text
route: Ledger tab — Send card payment link (text-to-pay; in sandbox it opens the practice’s Pay my bill page)
simulated: measured on the sandbox card processor (PAYMENTS=sandbox)

name: Complete the opening or closing checklist
Send patient education after a visit
Morning huddle
route: Today's dashboard (/) — fix flags on the row

name: Check the day sheet at the end of the day
Refer a patient to a specialist
Add a family member to a household
Record who referred a new patient
Text a reminder to everyone unconfirmed
route: Schedule → "N unconfirmed" → Text a reminder to all

name: Fix unsigned or incomplete notes (chart audit)
Change a patient's usual provider or hygienist
Add an office alert to a patient
See who is clocked in today
Void a payment posted by mistake
route: Ledger tab — the payment's row → Void (with a reason)

name: Look up remaining lab cases / what is overdue
Look at the production & collections report
Resend or fix a rejected claim
Order supplies that are running low
Block time on the schedule (meeting, lunch)
route: Schedule — drag on a chair → Block time

name: Reply to an online review
simulated: measured on the sandbox Google listing (GOOGLE_BUSINESS=sandbox)

name: Sign a patient up for the membership plan
Give a provider a day off or change their hours
route: Settings → Providers → Time off & special hours

name: Merge duplicate patient charts
route: Settings → Duplicate charts — Enter, MERGE, Enter

name: Review insurance A/R aging
route: Command bar "A/R aging" (Reports → Day sheet, production & A/R)

name: Check what the recall autopilot did
Reconcile insurance payments with the bank
Review phone results (missed calls, why they didn't book)
Log a sterilizer spore test
route: Checklists (a spore-test item on a checklist)

name: Post an announcement for the team
Export payroll
route: Command bar "export payroll" (downloads the pay period that just ended), or Time clock → Export

name: Ask a question about your numbers
Give a patient a copy of their record
Export a report to a spreadsheet
route: Command bar "export <report>" (downloads it at once), or Reports → any table → CSV

name: Correct a patient's name or date of birth
Switch to another office
route: Your name (bottom of the menu) → Office
simulated: measured with a second office added to the demo practice for the action

name: Check treatment plan acceptance
route: Command bar "treatment plan acceptance" (Reports → Treatment plans)

name: Check where new patients come from (referrals report)
Update an insurance (PPO) fee schedule
route: Settings → Fee updates & history (a payer’s new schedule waits there for approval)

name: Build or schedule a custom report
Look up who changed something (audit log)
Set up a perfect-day schedule template
Record a patient complaint or incident
route: Manage → Compliance log (/compliance) — N; command bar “Record a complaint or incident”

name: Log an exposure or sharps injury
route: Manage → Compliance log → Exposure log (/compliance?tab=exposures) — N

name: Track staff licenses, CPR and CE due dates
route: Documents → Staff licences & CPR (/documents?tab=staff): "maria cpr 10/30/2027", Enter — a to-do goes to the person 60 days before

name: Write a letter to a patient from a template
route: Family → Letters (/letters) — 1–9 picks the letter, Enter prints (filed on the chart), M emails; command bar “Write a letter”

name: Record a HIPAA disclosure (accounting of disclosures)
route: Manage → Compliance log → Disclosures (/compliance?tab=disclosures) — N; chart ⋯ → “Send the record to someone else…” records it automatically

name: Sell a product (toothbrush, whitening kit)
route: Account (ledger) → Sell a product — 1–9, Enter; command bar “Sell a product”

name: Print mailing labels
route: “Mailing labels” on Follow-up → Recall, on report results and on a campaign's audience

name: Check the prescription monitoring program (PDMP) before an opioid
route: Chart → Rx: a controlled drug → Check the PDMP (Enter) → Save & print

name: Mark a patient deceased
route: Chart ⋯ → Mark deceased, or Recall → Don’t recall… → Deceased: chart inactive, recall/statements/messages stopped, future visits cancelled (Undo)

name: Set up an online booking link
Connect an imaging bridge or integration
simulated: the operatory PC is simulated: a robot bridge starts with the key from the downloaded package

name: Sell or redeem a gift certificate
route: Account → Gift certificates (/gift-certificates) — N sells; ledger → “Gift certificate” uses one
